remarks: Introducing a pristine property in an ideal location for commuters, merely a few steps away from the Springdale train station and shopping facilities. This contemporary one-bedroom residence boasts a full bathroom, a radiant living room, and a newly fashioned kitchen equipped with quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances. Hardwood flooring is featured throughout the property, complemented by recessed lighting. Further amenities include gas heating and air conditioning, as well as laundry facilities within the unit. Enjoy the tranquility in this striking, fully revamped second floor home. Inquiries about pet ownership are welcome.
